author: TheJoseph21
body:
Hey!

I am fairly new to this community, but I am very experienced in the game modes of Avicus, because i play one year ago to OCN, so I ask you, please, they deem me for my statistics in Overcast Network (oc.tc / THEJOSEPH21) and not those of this community, because I do not play so long here.

IGN: THEJOSEPH21

Skype: JosephOCN

Activity (How long are you on daily?): 2, 3 or 4 Hours

Position Requested: Rush - Frontline

How will I benefit the team?: I have a great attitude, I like to help my teammates out in matches, and I'm almost always when I needed (More now on vacation)

Timezone: GMT -3 (Argentina)

Pros: Good at PVP (I mean :P), and very experienced in terms of bridging (That characterizes me) i dominated most of the styles of Bridges and Staircases (Including Breezily Bridge, a bridge without shift) but I'm still practicing Staircases without shift ^^

Cons:  I am new to the community (Which I explained at the beginning of the post) My ping (Very bad ping, since I live in Argentina, far from the host) and I have a poor level of English (If anyone in the clan can translate my language (Spanish) to  English, would be nice ^^  
 
Okay, that´s all, Greetings!
